concurrency_and_state: src/models/AntiLogin.java: All methods (canLogin, wrong, reset, getNotifyCannotLogin, isExpired) are synchronized on `this`, and `lastActivity` is volatile, but `wrongLogin` (byte) is `public` and non-volatile, allowing unsynchronized external access.
src/models/GiftCode.java: Uses non-thread-safe `HashMap` for `detail` and `option`, and plain `int countLeft`; relies on external synchronization in GiftCode service/manager.

tools/test/TestProfilerEngine.java: Spawns 10-thread FixedThreadPool with CountDownLatch gates to stress-test `PacketProfiler.gI()`, mutating real workspace files in `logs/metrics/` and `tools/memory/PERFORMANCE_ALERTS.json`.
tools/test/TestTelemetry.java: Mutates global static `TelemetryConfig` state (`ENABLED`, `STORAGE_DESTINATION`, `cloudEndpoint`, `WHITELIST_MAPS`) without restoring defaults in `finally`.
cross_module_questions: Does GiftCodeService/GiftCodeManager synchronize or lock around `GiftCode.countLeft` and `player.giftCode.isUsedGiftCode(code)` during redemption to prevent race-condition dupes?
Does any caller read or write `AntiLogin.wrongLogin` directly without going through `synchronized` methods, or call `wrong()` while already blocked (which could trigger `byte` overflow)?
Are `MobTemplate.hp` and `MapTemplate.mobHp` (`int` in `Template.java`) overflowing or capped for high-HP custom mobs/bosses compared to `NPoint.hpMax` (`long`)?
Is `TestProfilerEngine` safe to run in CI/dev without polluting `tools/memory/PERFORMANCE_ALERTS.json` and `logs/metrics/`?

db_redis_touchpoints.op: SELECT name, tile_id FROM map_template WHERE id = 187
db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Uses try-with-resources; hardcoded localhost:3308 root/root credentials; catches exception to skip test if DB unavailable.

db_redis_touchpoints.op: SELECT ip_address FROM account LIMIT 1; SELECT is_admin FROM account LIMIT 1

db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: UNSAFE: Neither Connection nor Statement uses try-with-resources; Statement is never closed and Connection leaks if an exception is thrown before line 21.
Delegates to DatabaseTemplateLoader (not in this batch).

findings.impact: If `wrong()` is invoked 128+ times without resetting (e.g., if caller doesn't gate on `canLogin()`), `wrongLogin` wraps to -128 (`< MAX_WRONG`), bypassing the brute-force login lockout. Public visibility also permits unsynchronized external mutation.
findings.root_cause: `wrongLogin` is declared `public byte wrongLogin` and incremented unboundedly (`wrongLogin++`) in `wrong()`. Also `timeCanLogin` (line 8) is dead state (written, never read).
findings.title: AntiLogin.wrongLogin uses signed byte that can overflow and is public non-volatile

findings.impact: JDBC `Statement` is leaked on every run, and `Connection` is leaked if `RedRibbonHQService` or any statement throws an exception.
findings.root_cause: `DriverManager.getConnection(...)` and `conn.createStatement()` are not wrapped in `try-with-resources`; `stmt` is unused and never closed, and `conn.close()` is outside `finally`.
findings.title: Resource leak in TestMobParse (missing try-with-resources)

findings.impact: Calling `timeCode()` on a `GiftCode` with null `datecreate` or `dateexpired` throws `NullPointerException`.
findings.root_cause: `this.datecreate.getTime() > this.dateexpired.getTime()` lacks null checks on either `Timestamp` field.
findings.title: Potential NPE in GiftCode.timeCode() when timestamps are null

findings.impact: Increases risk of inconsistent state between `skills` array and `skillss` list, and fragile index alignment across parallel arrays in `MapTemplate`.
findings.root_cause: `SkillTemplate` declares both `Skill[] skills` and `List<Skill> skillss = new ArrayList<>()`; `MapTemplate` stores mob/npc attributes in separate parallel primitive arrays.
findings.title: Template.java has duplicated skill collections and parallel arrays in MapTemplate

findings.impact: Test 18 fails whenever `WhisArenaService.getRemainingMinutes()` is not 101; TestProfilerEngine pollutes real `PERFORMANCE_ALERTS.json` and `logs/metrics/` files.
findings.root_cause: `TestWhisArenaLogic` asserts `expectedHeader.contains("101 phút nữa")`, and `TestProfilerEngine` writes directly to production metrics/alert paths instead of temp directories.
findings.title: Brittle time-dependent assertion in TestWhisArenaLogic and side-effects in TestProfilerEngine

module_summary: Batch tooling_and_tests__p01 covers 3 core model classes (AntiLogin, GiftCode, Template) and 9 standalone test/diagnostic runners (Whis Arena, TLS, MySQL connection, Namec AI, PacketProfiler, Telemetry, and RedRibbonHQ mob loading). No custom game protocol opcodes are serialized/deserialized in this batch. Key issues include byte overflow & public field exposure in AntiLogin, an unclosed JDBC Connection/Statement in TestMobParse, and test side-effects/brittle assertions in TestProfilerEngine and TestWhisArenaLogic.
